headline: Choose your SPF. Each one is tested in vivo.
footnote: SPF of each sunscreen confirmed by in-vivo testing to ISO 24444:2019 in independent third-party labs. Apply at least 15 minutes before sun exposure; reapply with continued sun exposure.
layout_description: Square 1080x1080. Headline centred across the top band in deep cobalt-navy, one or two lines. Three real pack shots (Light Fluid SPF 50 as the main product in the centre, SPF 50 Sunscreen left, SPF 60 Sunscreen right) stand in a row across the middle 80% of the frame on the tabletop, evenly spaced. Each pack has a small rectangular label tag above or angled beside it carrying its range label in navy on white. Footnote in small grey text centred along the bottom. 'Shop now' as a small navy outlined button bottom-centre, below the footnote line or at bottom-right.
image_prompt: Square 1080x1080 background-only scene. Top-down-to-three-quarter view of a warm off-white linen surface in soft morning sunlight, with gentle, diffused sun streaks and a faint soft-edged leaf shadow only along the very top and bottom edges. A single pair of light-framed sunglasses lies folded at the extreme bottom-left corner as the only prop. Warm, summery but minimal mood; palette of off-white, pale sand and a hint of soft sunny yellow in the light, with muted cobalt only as a faint cool tone in shadows. Keep the middle 80% of the frame completely clear, flat and evenly lit for three products placed side by side, and keep the top band calm and low-detail for the headline. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands; also no tube. Empty space reserved for the product photos and copy to be added later.
adaptation_notes: Kept: the range-picker 'choose yours' framing, several sunscreens shown together in one frame each with its own short label, a sunny lifestyle mood (toned down to warm off-white light and one sunglasses prop), and a shop-now CTA. Labels use each product's own SPF number and a cited texture or ingredient fact instead of the source's cooling/brightening/hydrating/oil-control menu. Dropped: the '100% new-gen UV filters' badge (a technology claim with no matching fact); the beach basket and patterned rug (too busy for the copy and pack areas); a fourth variant (only three sunscreens are in the input). Proof is moved to the footnote: each SPF is in-vivo tested to ISO 24444:2019 by independent labs, which is in all three fact sheets.
